title: Billion-Dollar US Disasters Now Hit Every 18 Days
hook: Billion-dollar US disasters are no longer rare events.
closing: More frequent disasters raise the insurance and tax costs that households ultimately carry.
question: Has one reached your town?

segments.say: Billion-dollar US disasters now average 20.4 yearly, turning exceptional events into a near-monthly burden.
The US recorded 28 disasters in 2023, more than three times the long-run yearly average.
Since 1980, US disasters cost $2,635.1 billion. Insurers, taxpayers, and households ultimately absorb that bill.
